notes.title: Patch Update 1.1 - Raid: Interdimensional Threat
notes.content:
Patch 1.1 — Raid: Interdimensional Threat
First off, thank you again for playing and supporting 9 Days. Patch 1.1 is here, and it’s one of the biggest updates yet. 

This update will test your wits, strength, and skill. There are no hints. Every challenge must be solved by you, the player.
⚔️ New Raid: Interdimensional Threat
A new raid-style activity has been added. (You can find this in the Plane of Existence, after you have unlocked the Universal Prison).

Features brand-new story content, characters, and lore tied to the fallout of the Universal Order.

Face a devastating new enemy race and uncover what their arrival means for the universe.

The raid is the only way to obtain new Prime Items and powerful pieces of armour.
🛡️ Prime & Armour Expansion
New Prime Items added to the pool.

Additional armour sets tied to the new raid challenges.
🤜 Throws Reworked
Throws are no longer static. They will now change based on your melee type.
🏆 Achievements
New achievements have been added, tied to the raid and new gameplay content.

HOT FIX UPDATE:
- FINAL BOSS LESS DIALOGUE AND LOWER VOLUME SO YOU CAN HEAR BETTER.
- VISUAL CONES FOR 4TH ENCOUNTER SO YOU CAN SEE WHERE NOT TO GO.
- HARD MODE LAST ENCOUNTER ARMOUR STATS BOOSTED.

Those who are having difficulty with the Raid below is a simple guide on each puzzle. If you want to work it out yourself don't watch this video.


[previewyoutube="UAeEcc4viec;full"][/previewyoutube]




[hr][/hr]
Thank you for standing with me on this journey. Excited to see you play this one.

— The Dev

notes.title: Patch 1.092 Adjustments
notes.content:
Patch Notes – Minor Update

Following yesterday’s patch, a few quick adjustments have been made:

Meditation Table – True Protector Path: You can now allocate more than one point per click.

Kod’s Wings: Adjusted to fire projectiles more frequently.

Muzayafists Clones: Clones should now agro quicker. (Note: They are still on a cooldown – if your clones die, you will need to wait 3 minutes.)

Infusor Primes: Adjustments made to ensure they work correctly.

Null Horizon Trials: Boss health has been reduced.

Rewards Adjustment: Rewards in both the Null Horizon and Interdimensional Games now grant higher stat increases per level.

notes.title: Patch 1.092 - Prime Armour Update
notes.content:
Patch 1.092 – Prime Armour
This patch focuses on expanding Prime Armours and introducing a new challenge in the Null Horizon.
 New Prime Additions
Kod’s Wings have been added to the Null Horizon Prime Armour pool. 

Muzayafists now summon clones to assist in battle. (Clones scale with Players Health and Strength).
 New Prime Item: Infusor
A number of you have asked about combining multiple Prime Armours. 

Infusor Prime Armour randomly fuses two different Prime properties into one piece.

When you find an Infusor, check the description to see which traits you’ve inherited.

Over 20 unique combinations are possible.
 The Ultimate Trial Awaits…
A new trial has appeared in the Null Horizon — the most difficult challenge in the game to date.

This is the only way to obtain Infusor Prime Armour.

Five escalating trials.
 Balance Changes
Solar Rain: Reduced damage slightly. Now always consumes 10% of your energy bar on use.

Hammerhead Melee Buff: Increased melee damage — stronger than ever.

Grakzul Adjustment: Now spawns directly on the player to ensure proper aggro.
[hr][/hr]
Thanks again for all the feedback and support!
Excited to see the new Infusor builds people discover — keep sharing your combinations and chaos!

notes.title: Patch 1.092 – Minor Adjustment Patch
notes.content:
Patch 1.092 – Minor Adjustment Patch

This patch makes balance tweaks, bug fixes.
[hr][/hr] What’s new & adjusted
Transformations have been boosted for even more power.

Furyborn build has been buffed.

Soulbinders: Energy Bomb, Machine, Air Cutter, and Mana Wave all do more damage.

Melee overall buffed – especially when using Hammerhead or Infernaskin.

Big damage numbers are back!
Damage numbers have been visually inflated for that satisfying screen-filling effect.
(This is purely visual – your actual damage hasn’t changed. You can turn big numbers off in game settings.)

Fixed bug where Prime Armour was wrongly increasing stats unequipped.

Solar Rain now consumes more energy.

The Prison gets tougher after level 54 for those chasing harder fights – and your armour stat numbers will scale up too.

No longer a cap on energy dropped from Grakzul and the Warden fight.
[hr][/hr] Tips for the new patch
Hammerhead + Saber Slash + True Protector: massive damage and lots of healing while attacking.

Furyborn + True Protector: set Homing Fury traps before the boss spawns, then use Rapid Volley for huge damage spikes.

Sharpshot + True Protector: Solar Arrow and Solar Rain will melt anything.

Soulbinders + Omni: Mana Wave heals and hits hard, and boosts your Spirit attacks.
[hr][/hr] Extra advice
Transformations can go beyond level 4!
Stay transformed and defeat enemies to keep powering up:

Omni: watch your Spirit, Strength and Focus increase (check the Omni tooltip).

True Protector: keep fighting, then spend your earned points at the table.

Build your loadout around your playstyle.
Example: Soulbinders work best with high Arcane & Spirit stats – try farming the Interdimensional Games or Null Horizon for gear to boost those stats.
[hr][/hr]
Thank you all so much for playing and sharing your feedback.
Keep the ideas and discoveries coming – there are still many hidden combos waiting to be found!

Image by Chaos - a member in the discord community!

notes.title: Patch 1.092 - Number Rework
notes.content:
Patch Notes – Scaling Update
Don’t panic — the lower numbers are by design!

The main focus of this patch is to scale things down. Astronomically high damage numbers were causing issues for the game engine, so we’ve adjusted numbers across the board.

Hitting in the thousands is now considered the new million

Boss health has been scaled down too, so fights remain balanced

Every playstyle has been significantly buffed — but you’ll need to invest in specific stats, prime armour, and transformations to unlock high damage potential. Try out all the skills to see what has been changed. You might find a hidden playstyle which you like.
[hr][/hr] Combat & Scaling Changes
Check Melee descriptions for new scaling types and stat influences

Prime Item adjustments: further support for unique playstyles

Mana Wave now scales with Arcane and Spirit

Air Cutter scales with Arcane, Spirit, and Strength

Hamian Hammer scales with Strength, Fury, and Dexterity

Saber Slash scales with Strength and Dexterity

Flury scales with Strength and Spirit

Inferno Hammer scales with Strength and Fury

Normal Melee scales with Strength and Dexterity

Dexterity increases further through the Energy Control stat

Arcane increases through Omni Focus
[hr][/hr] New & Adjusted Features
Omni points can now be earned by defeating enemies while staying transformed

New concentration platforms on Pilgrim Planet, Central — let you focus on specific Omni types

Earn points while defeating enemies in True Protector

New Power Rating in the Energy Menu shows your overall strength

Moon Base armour rewards now scale with the day you visit — later days = stronger armour

Universal Prison Upgrade: after defeating the Fifth Prisoner at 100%, you can upgrade the prison for stronger prisoners and better rewards
[hr][/hr] And finally…
Thank you to everyone for your feedback, support, and patience.

Please remember to back up your save files before the upcoming Cloud Saving update!

(Find your saves in: AppData/Local/FifteenDays/Saved/SaveGames)

notes.title: Patch 1.091 - Update
notes.content:
Patch 1.091 – Minor Update


Cloud Saving

Fixed Gatekeeper of the Fifth sometimes getting stuck.

Fixed bug where transforming into True Protector + Omen with a power up would incorrectly stack power ups.

Fixed stash issue where adding items back sometimes showed wrong stats or failed to move them.
[hr][/hr] Gameplay & Balance
Omen Upgrade power up now scales with your Arcane stat.

Omni Omen power up now scales with your Dexterity stat.

Omni points now distributed to better balance with True Protector skill points:

Kod now mostly specializes in Strength.

Afran specializes in Omni Spirit.

Focus points have been increased in the flying challenge.

[hr][/hr] Progression & Rewards

Enemies on Pilgrim Planet buffed significantly for more challenge.

Interdimensional Level now saves after NG+.

Interdimensional starting prices are lower by design, so coin returns scale differently:

Starting at preset levels = lower cost & lower coin reward.

Starting at your highest level = higher cost & higher coin reward.

notes.title: Patch 1.091
notes.content:
Hey team! I have been doing a bunch of shadow updates fixing bugs but I will list down everything that has been updated/fixed.
Patch 1.091

 HP Recharge now faster charge rate depending on your Spirit.
 "Stash", has been renamed to "Your Stash" for new players who don't understand the Stash system.
 Interdimensional Games now will remember your highest round and you can choose to continue if you leave the area after you fold.
 Sphere attacks from Elder Spirits now despawn after 10 seconds.
 Stats issue should be fixed, sometimes not showing correct stats.
 Crusty Castle, Divine Dojo and Coastlands have better loading.
 Moon Tournament, removed the cannot heal requirement.
 Sword, Staff, Saber Slash and Inferno Hammer have increased damage.
 Kod now gives more Omni points depending on which version you beat.
 Kod 100% resets on defeat.
 Gegan, school position changed as new players confused this with the side quest with the nurse.
 Players are now alerted when Razul gives flight back in the past.
 You can choose between 100 % Grakzul and 100 % Warden in the Universal Prison.
 Ragdolling removed as people sometimes went through the floor.
 Crouch jumping hint been added for those struggling with jumping on the rocks.
 Better descriptions for Prime Armours.


Tips
I know a lot of people rely on Air Cutter for the late as for the damage input, but I will give a few tips on other methods for gaining even greater damage for the later bosses. Then you can experiment with other skills.

Sharpshot
The Prime Armour was designed to significantly improve a playstyle. So for example: 
Sharpshot gives tracking for the Solar Arrow skill and does damage based on Dexterity and Fury. If you invest into those stats with Sharpshot equipped, you will do a ton of damage! 

Soulbinders
Another example is Soulbinders:
Soulbinders make Spirit and Arcane skills draw from each other so Energy Bomb for example will do significant damage once equipped. Same goes for the Arcane based skills such as the Mana Wave. Mana Wave will do more damage on tick. 

I will let you all do some testing with this and find the best builds!

P.S 

I have seen the issues regarding some stats not applying to your character. If you have this issue, flying into another zone or reloading that level will fix it.

Thanks!

notes.title: Patch 1.081 - Hot Fixes
notes.content:
Hot Fixes

Interdimensional Games Armour error

You would have noticed some huge spikes in armour values - easily going up to the thousands. This was a bug in the logic. Instead of adding values I multiplied and on top of that I added an extra '0' by accident! 

The correct way the armour should spike is the game level you are on will be added on to the default armour values. An example would be if you got to Level 50. 50 would be spiked onto random categories added onto the default values.  

This still makes the armour pieces the strongest in the game but no completely busted such as almost reaching 10,000. This is my error and apologies! 

Your current armour that you have earned within the games will now reflect the changes. Also, if you have used cheat engine, your armour values might also get changed. 

As a result of my mistake, I have changed the drops so that two armour pieces spawn after you collect and you get a Void Coin (the value is increased based on level). 

I have also fixed the Third Razul bug and sometimes the proceed game didn't start. 

Thanks for understanding!

notes.title: Patch 1.081 - Interdimensional Games and Tutorial Update
notes.content:

New Interdimensional Games

Located in the Fifth Dimension in the contract zone, there is a new game mode for those wishing to challenge their skills. You will face enemies one on one, after you defeat the enemy, you can choose to take the reward or keep going. Each time you progress, the enemies get tougher but the rewards equally get better. The catch is, healing is disabled. You cannot heal while the games are active. This will be the place where you will get the best armour pieces. 

New Tutorial Visual Update

Functionally the Tutorial remains pretty much the same. But there is a huge update on the visuals. More looking like the original tutorial back in the vanilla launch. Let me know if you like it. 

Skills adjustment

Rapid Blast did not scale at all with Fury previously. This has been fixed.
Machine Blast while flying did not scale with Spirit has been fixed.
Mana Wave now scales more accurately with Arcane.
Fury Volley has an increased Headshot multiplier. 
Arrow has an increased Headshot multiplier. 
Arrow rain has increased damage.
Homing Fury has increased damage.

Markers for Protes quest updates when Council's Golden Supplies are destroyed. 
Markers for Bomb Quest are visually updated when a bomb is destroyed before taking the quest.
AI when facing Kod are more active in their attacks.
Absorb Sun now takes less time.
Bosses have had increased health to compensate for the player buffs.

Thanks for reading and playing the game! More updates to come!

notes.title: Patch 1.08 - Now LIVE!
notes.content:
9 Days - Patch 1.08 Update

Thank you again to the incredible 9 Days community. I hope you all enjoyed the massive 1.07 update! With Patch 1.08, I’m adding a new story mission, new modes, quality-of-life improvements, and a handful of important fixes. Let’s jump into it:

New Questline: The Third

A new questline titled The Third is now available in the past timeline. This marks the final chapter in the questline from the past and serves as a conclusion to the main questline. 

New Mode: Sandbox Mode

Introducing Sandbox Mode! This mode is built for players who want full access to all skills, rare equipment, and more right from the start. It's perfect for testing out builds, experimenting with powers, or just enjoying the world without progression limitations. You can still play the full story while in Sandbox Mode.

New Mode: Survival Mode

Survival Mode offers a true hardcore experience: one life, no second chances. This mode is for those seeking the ultimate challenge.

Fast Travel Portals

To make navigation smoother, Fast Travel Portals have been added to each major location. Once you visit a new location and complete a single quest there, a portal will unlock—cutting down on the number of loading screens between destinations.

New Achievements

New achievements have been added to reflect the content introduced in this update, including Sandbox, Survival Mode, and The Third questline.

Replaced AI Voices + New Cinematics

I’ve replaced all previous AI-generated voices with professional voice acting to enhance immersion and emotional impact. On top of that, several new cinematics have been added to key story moments to further elevate the experience.

Bug Fixes & Changes

Settings Menu: Volume settings now properly save and load. (Works on my end—let me know if it works for you!)

Final Boss Buffed: With all the new energy systems and questlines, the final boss was feeling too easy. Expect a tougher fight now.

New Icons: Stash locations, Change Appearance scrolls, and other key items now have clearer UI icons on the map.

Wrath Bug Fixed: This was supposed to be an entry-level power boost and has now been corrected.

New Voice Clips: Transformations now come with new voice lines.

Kod’s Gauntlet Update: Kod now has a fifth and final stage—100% power.

New Areas: Two new zones have been added to the Plane of Existence as part of story progression.

New Appearance Drop: A story-related item that unlocks a brand-new look.

Clean Feed Toggle: A new menu feature has been added to toggle Clean Feed, allowing you to remove the UI for those who want to take clean screenshots or videos.

While this marks the end of the main storyline quests, there may be more stories to tell in the future. For now, I’ll be focusing on continued polishing, UI/menu improvements, and bug fixes.

Thank you so much for sticking with 9 Days. I hope you enjoy Patch 1.08.

- The Dev

notes.title: PATCH 1.075 UPDATE!
notes.content:
A big thank you to everyone for continuing to support 9 Days! This update brings some exciting new content, quality-of-life improvements, and bug fixes to make the experience even better. 

New Content & Features

Kod's Gauntlet

The ultimate challenge has arrived. Kod's Gauntlet is a battle unlike any other—each time you defeat Kod, he returns stronger until he reaches his full power. This is the toughest fight in the game, designed for those seeking the greatest challenge. Kod's Gauntlet is available in the Plane of Existence after completing the post-mission following Universal Battle.

Changing Appearance (Transmog System)

Want to keep your stats but switch up your look? Be on the lookout for a Golden Scroll near the main towns. This scroll allows you to change your current appearance to any item in your stash. You can also remove custom appearances and restore your default armor look within the same menu.

New Achievements

Additional achievements have been added to reflect the new story missions in the game.

More Rare Hidden Materials in Space

Venture into main space areas to discover new rare hidden materials. Keep exploring—you never know what you might find!

Quest Improvements

Cyborg despawns once you have left the area.

Hamian Training will remain available until you start the Universal Battle quest.

Aras Relics Quest – Markers have been placed to help find the relics.

Desert Haunt Mission – Markers have been added to improve guidance.

Various Quest Marker Name Changes – More clarity on objectives.

Energy Absorption Quests – Now absorbs energy immediately instead of requiring additional steps.

Bug Fixes & Improvements

Numbers on Health and Energy Bars – Now displayed for better tracking.

Time Slow Fix – Time slow should no longer work on strong bosses.

Parrying Adjustments – If a boss is immune, parrying will no longer deal damage.

Colossal Blast Camera Fix – Camera now pans out properly when using Colossal Blast.

Omni-Training Clarification – Some players thought Omni-Training was bugged. It is not. Since there is no cap to the amount of training you can do, changes may appear small in single increments. Example: After 30 points invested into Spirit, Energy Bomb increased from 6,000 to 32,000.

Pilgrim Training Fix – Fixed overlapping boss names.

Past Content Warning – Players entering the past (post-game content) will now receive warnings. Be prepared—warriors in the past are much stronger than the rest of the game.

Thank you all for playing 9 Days! Your support and feedback mean everything, and there's even more exciting content coming soon. Stay tuned for what's next!

- The Dev

notes.title: ONE YEAR UPDATE NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
9 Days - Patch 1.07 Update

First off, a huge thank you to everyone who has supported 9 Days in its first year. The journey hasn’t been without its challenges, but through it all, the community’s belief in the game has been incredible. Your feedback, dedication, and passion keep 9 Days growing stronger with every update.
Now, let’s get into what’s new in Patch 1.07!

Here is the preview video if you do not want to read the patch notes:

There are new quests in nearly all the areas but if you want to follow the main story, visit The Oracle in the Past. (This will only be available after completing the main story in the past and the 9th Day).  

[previewyoutube=bQwwAx6VUoY;full][/previewyoutube]

Added Content

 New Story Mission: "Universal Battle" – The final chapter of the 9 Days main story. 
 Extra Questlines – New adventures await after the 9th Day.
 New Past Questlines – Expanded stories in the Main City Area and School Area.
 New Pilgrim Planet Content – Additional questlines and activities to explore.
 New Fifth Dimension Questlines – Uncover more about this mysterious realm.
 New Planet Hara Quests – Fresh stories in Volley Village, Fox School, Fearful Forest, and Flight School.
 New Planet Balu Quests – Discover more in King City and the Ruins.


Armor, Energy, and Skill Updates

 New Armor Pieces – More options for battle and exploration.
 New Energy to Collect – Expand your power.
 Energy Bomb Buff – Now stronger and capable of destroying planets again.
 Beam Buff – Increased power and effectiveness.
 Arrow & Arrowbeam Skill Buffed – Increased damage.
 Colossal Blast Auto-Tracking – Now locks onto enemies.
 Energy Vanish Mechanic – Can now vanish while using certain energy attacks.
 Omnipresence Upgrade – Omnipresence now has an additional enhancement, and Omen & True Protector have been upgraded.
 Transform While Powering Up – No need to stop charging to ascend.
 Chain Transform While Powering Up – Example: Omen → True Protector.


Visual, Quest, and Bug Fixes

 Marker Visual Update – Improved clarity for objectives.
 Better Quest Guidance – More accurate markers for smoother gameplay.
 Flight School Visual Overhaul – Now has a Dojo-style update.
 Flight School Quest Improvement – Flight automatically equipped.
 Warp Speed Auto-Unlock – Gained after collecting 5 Orbs in Flight School.
 Dojo Quest Update – Bomb locations adjusted for better pacing.
 Clearing the Bunker for Mar Rewards – Now properly grants rewards.
 Queen Bug Fix – "Talk to Queen" marker now works correctly.
 Tournament Reset Improvement – No longer need to leave and re-enter.
 Flying Through Terrain Upgrade – Improved handling and smoother flying through terrain.
 Shiny Animal Material Fix – Correct materials now drop.
 Pure Phantom Quest Fix – Markers properly removed when binding object is destroyed.
 Camera Sensitivity Fix – Works correctly while flying.
 Crusty Castle Spawn Fix – No more unexpected spawn issues.
 Game of Realms Text Bug Fixed – No more incorrect closure messages.
 Sun Absorption Speed Increased – Players now receive immediate visual feedback when absorbing the sun.
 Space Visual Update – Space is now darker, adding a sense of mystery and depth.
 Black Hole Visual Update – Improved aesthetic and realism.


This is just another step forward, and I will never stop working to make 9 Days the best experience possible. Your feedback means everything, and I’m always listening for ways to improve. Enjoy the update—I can’t wait to see everyone playing it!

There are things I wasn’t able to do in time that will be rolled out in a future update. Transmog armour pieces is a big one I am working on for the next patch.

Please enjoy this patch and thank you for a year of 9 Days!

notes.title: Patch 1.07 - 1 Year Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42622525/8fc1cb430b43ebe52ca621722fac0da4aa56527a.png

Hello everyone! Thanks for almost one year of 9 Days. It has come by so fast and I am so appreciative of everyone who played it. I have been working on a big update for the 1 Year anniversary. This includes a new main story quest which will wrap up the story, many many new side quests, new things to do, gameplay improvements and bug fixes. Hey all, I see a lot of people dealing with crashes and this is the main focus of this hot fix. 

Based on the feedback, it seems many of you get crashes after defeating an enemy, annihilation blast and sometimes just flying in the world. It also seems many people who played the 1.04 didn't experience these crashes. 

I do not know what is the main source of the crash but I have reverted some things that could be the issue. I have also done a few other fixes that have been brought up.

- I have disabled dynamic hit reactions on enemies. 
- VFX on Spirits have been disabled.
- Optimisations methods on NPCs have been reverted
- Annihilation blasts do not destroy the environment and only track to enemies. 
- Opening World should have decreased loading times.
- The Kings City on Balu has been optimised. 
- Beam damage has been increased and VFX is less transparent. 
- The Final Boss Health has been slightly reduced. 
- Lock on does not seek another enemy after death.

Please let me know if crashes are still persistent, I would like to fix this as soon as possible but it is hard to replicate on my end. 

P.S 

A quick google showed that having "Game Mode" turned on in Windows can cause crashes. If you switch it off in 'Setting/Gaming/Game Mode' it might help. 

Thanks!

notes.title: NEW COMBAT WIP SHOWCASE
notes.content:
Hey all, I know some of you may not be in the discord but I want to share some progress I have made to the combat system. 

FLYING COMBAT 

I want everything you can do on the ground to translate to flying too. Here is a WIP video of how that is looking so far. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2-xqV6H9r4A





MELEE COMBAT 

First, although directional dodging is in the game with "fast dash" and "roll", I have decided to make it a primary feature for dodging attacks. When locked on, you can dodge the enemies attacks as seen below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42622525/127193a3d93c9fa720089492be3c0e71adcea069.gif




KNOCKBACK

There are a few new mechanics for melee strikes now. First "Knockback". At the end of your string combo, it will have a knockback effect. You could decide to end the combo there with a energy attack.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42622525/08b1f0ad74c48fd7ee80ddb84b0046f45357d14d.gif


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42622525/1f68fdb6ef934d66759c667afb0a9324d8991689.gif



COMBAT DASH

A new mechanic called "Combat dash" allows you to dash in after a knockback strike. You can follow this with another string + a energy attack of your choice as a finisher. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42622525/1089fce2ebc2f7e8497c9ae746c586082138ef1b.gif



CHARGED CRUSH

Another new mechanic called "Charged Crush" is activated when holding the melee attack down. Charged Crush will activate a knockback if successfully landed. This attack will crush through enemy attacks and will not interrupt your animation. (As noted by the white aura around your player). If you decide to end your combo with a "Charged Crush" this will knock the player down instead of further up.

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
Hi everyone, here are the notes for Patch 1.03

1. Fixed Key binding issues:

Input should display correct devices, eg if you are using controller or keyboard.
Key binding should now work with controller inputs.
Resetting defaults for controller works correctly.
Added locking on key bind.

2. Hoverboard bug (working progress) :

The Hoverboard bug is tied to framerate, it seems that the bug will occur during 30 FPS. I have fixed so with a framerate of 60 or higher it will work normally but currently 30 FPS or lower will still make it spin.

3. Fixed Relic quest bug:

If you were to fly to the Witches Hut, it sometimes loaded the tutorial level again resetting day progress.
Finishing Relic Quest now drops armour.

4. Fixed Final boss bug:

When trying to retrieve your body, the cutscene may loop.

5. Fixed R+F Transform glitch:
If you press R+F, you could transform without even unlocking the form.

6. Controller players can now toggle fast flight without holding the sprint button down.

7. Falling through map, falling through the map is not completely fixed but there is a check now that if you are falling, you will teleport back to your last spot.

8. Fearful Forest has higher brightness.

9. Map will guide players better.
Locations will be automatically unlocked on the map.
New player location icon which now shows the direction you are facing in the world. This is based on camera facing direction.

10. The Astronaut that gives you warp drive will always spawn in, even if you kill him.

11. Crouch was binded to left-alt and left-ctrl. Now it is only binded to left-ctrl. You can change this in the rebind settings if you would like.

12. Ocean water damage nerf.

13. The Phase dash has be reverted back to using the player facing direction rather than the camera direction.

Thanks again for playing 9 Days, it has been so cool seeing your different builds and strategies. 
I will be looking at making a better tutorial next for new players and making major improvements to the combat system. 

Oh and of course... bugs!

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Patch 1.02!

I have listened to the feedback and have implemented the most important tasks first. 

1. The first task that many of you wanted was more guidance to Quests. When you now press the block button, it will show markers for Quests you are currently able to do. When you progress in that quest, the marker will guide you to the next area.

(If you are currently doing a Quest when this new update roles out, the Quest tracker may not update till you have finished that part of the quest)

2. Leveling up your energy capacity. You gain experience for all enemies you defeat. Getting enough exp points will level you up, adding to your total energy capacity. The difficulty of the enemies will increase the exp you gain. You can check your experience points in the Energy Menu.

3. Made the blacklist system less brutal. Before if you were to attack a NPC in the area of a Quest giver, they will not want to talk to you. Now if you attack an NPC, the Quest giver will still talk to you but be careful not to kill the actual Quest giver, they will remain dead. Guards now will still attack you but after you load in again they will "forgive you" for attacking the town.

4. Night time brightness increased heaps.

5. Better hints to the bomb locations.

6. Better guidance on where to go in the final boss segment.

7. You can find Forge easier instead of finding the moon.

8. Player ragdoll has been disabled - this was causing a lot of issues of players falling through the map.

Thank you for still with the game and providing excellent feedback. I am next going to look at the hoverboard bug and the key bindings issue in the menu.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Hey team I have seen your feedback and made a quick patch.

1. Tutorial is made easier and tips will reappear if you miss them. Instead of collecting the skill (many 
people dashed past them), it is automatically put in your collected skills.

2. Dojo challenges are a bit easier, Orb flies slower with a bigger hit box. The aiming task is increased by 20 seconds.

3. The Guardian has been nerfed, his damaged is decreased and he doesn't hit you back as far.

4. Hoverboard is inside the first castle area to make travelling easier.

Thanks again for the feedback guys, I will do the bigger tasks next
